title: How Apifiny's Trading Network Will Make Crypto Markets 'More Efficient And Healthy'
description:
Apple Inc (NASDAQ: AAPL) stock trades the same price no matter what platform is being used to get exposure to a market.

US companies added 296,000 jobs in April, more than double the expected amount and the most since July.


Not exactly what the Fed wants to see.
